method: Codex gpt-6.1-sol (max) triaged docs/coverage/mss-gaps.json into teach, fingerprint and drop; a Claude Sonnet 5.5 worker grouped the teach entries into reusable patterns that name no game, moving game-specific detail to fingerprints; Claude Opus 5.5 reviewed both and reworded five patterns that stated one game's configuration as a universal rule. Each pattern's evidence is the union of its members' evidence.
denominator: A family is full when every teach entry in it is taught; teach entries are taught through their pattern. The patterns and the classes below are fixed and are not changed afterwards.

patterns.statement: Score aces as 11 unless that busts, else 1. Only an unsplit opening two-card 21 is a natural; other 21s are ordinary and auto-stand. A bust ends the hand. Verify soft-hard transitions.

Settle in order: player bust loses; dealer natural beats all but a player natural, which pushes; player natural pays its premium; dealer bust pays; then compare totals, equal pushing. Verify every pair.

Dealer draws below 17; declare soft-17 behaviour (S17 stands, H17 draws) and whether it draws only while a non-bust, non-natural hand remains. Verify soft-17 fixtures and no extra draws in all-bust, natural and surrender layouts.

Declare the peek policy: with a peek on Ace or ten upcards a dealer natural ends the round before paid actions; without one, added Double and Split stakes also lose to a later natural. Verify liability.

Natural premium (half profit) and insurance (half stake) must land on the wallet grid: require grid-even stakes, or floor each hand's return separately, never the aggregate. Verify odd-unit stakes against aggregate-floor counterexamples.

Per new shoe, reveal one burn card and discard extra cards equal to its hard value (ace 1, ten-value 10), or burn exactly one when declared. Verify composition, cursor and ledger counts before dealing.

Never change shoes mid-hand: check the cut card or reshuffle threshold only between rounds, finish the current round, then reshuffle from the persistent stream and reset the cursor. Verify cuts reached during draws and stream parity.

Offer insurance only on a dealer Ace for half the opening stake, if affordable; it returns principal plus premium only on a dealer natural, else is lost. Verify unaffordable stakes and both settlements.

Double only an untouched non-natural two-card hand with an allowed total (split hands too): debit its full current stake, draw exactly one card, then force stand or bust. Verify funding, eligibility and aces.

Split pairs (declare value-equal or exact rank) for an equal stake within funding and hand caps; seat the sibling beside the current hand; deal second cards in declared order. Verify pair test, order and caps.

Split aces take exactly one card each and cannot draw further or Double, except eligible re-splits below the hand cap; at the cap, finish pending ace hands automatically. Verify cap transitions and re-split funding.

Look up pair, then soft, then hard total; each Double or Split cell names a draw-or-stand fallback when rules or funds forbid it. Require complete own-key custom charts, rejecting missing, inherited or altered cells. Verify lookup priority.

Evaluate 21+3 only from the player's two opening cards plus the dealer upcard, in order: suited trips, straight flush, trips, straight, flush. A-2-3 and Q-K-A are straights, K-A-2 is not. Verify exclusive categories.

Ace 1, ten/faces 0, total mod 10; naturals 8/9 stop; Player draws on 0–5. Banker draws on 0–2, on 3 unless Player's third is 8, 4:2–7, 5:4–7, 6:6–7, never on 7; if Player stood, on 0–5. Verify the tableau.

Round winnings per accepted chip on the wallet grid in the declared direction (banker 0.95: half-up or floor), add that chip's principal, then sum; commission is stake minus profit. Verify minimum stakes and per-chip versus merged boundaries.

Pair side bets compare only that side's original two cards by rank, not value, independent of the main result and later cards. Verify different ten-value ranks, initial pairs and misleading later pairs.

Validate inside bets against declared table adjacency, including which zero splits, trios or first-four exist; expand announced bets into their declared unit layouts (for example 9/6/5 units, 17 covered twice) and floor only the summed constituent return. Verify every pocket.

One single-zero pocket settles every spot: add principal plus profit for all covering spots, overlaps included; declare zero handling: outside bets simply lose, or la partage or en prison apply. Verify pocket coverage and multiple returns.
Three-dice small wins sums 4–10, big 11–17, odd/even follow sum parity, total bets need the exact sum, and any triple loses small, big, odd and even. Verify all 216 ordered outcomes.

Any triple: three equal dice; specific triple: three chosen faces; pair: at least two chosen faces (triples count); combo: both distinct faces, ascending order; number bet: only the tier matching the occurrence count, never summed. Verify all outcomes.

Check stop lines before each hand against a declared denominator: absolute bankroll, or bankroll minus committed stake, versus profit and loss thresholds; a run may end with zero hands. Verify both at opening.

When the next strategic stake exceeds bankroll or table limit, either stop or reset the progression to its opening plan and retry, rejecting unplayed spins if still impossible. Declare which; verify reset scope.
Martingale doubles per consecutive loss, resetting on a win or max step; Paroli doubles per consecutive win, resetting on a loss or capped step; a push freezes both. Verify caps and next stakes.

Stake = base × unit(index): D'Alembert +1 on loss, −1 on win (minimum 1); Fibonacci +1 place on loss, −2 on win; 1-3-2-6 advances on win, resets on loss or final step; pushes freeze. Verify edge indices.

Labouchère stakes first plus last (the sole unit if one remains); a win deletes both ends, a loss appends the stake; an empty line or table-limit reset restores the initial line. Verify one-item and reset cases.

Oscar's Grind tracks cycle profit, stakes just enough to reach a one-unit goal (at least one chip), raises the unit only after a win in an incomplete cycle, and resets at the goal. Verify partial goals.

Scale a fixed-ratio multi-spot spread as one unit to the largest affordable whole-chip plan under the table limit; never cap spots independently; reject the spin if the minimum spread cannot fit. Verify ratios.

Pre-deadline undo cancels each original debit once, drops tickets from settlement and volume, and tombstones the command so replay refunds nothing; a refund is never a win. By amount, remove whole tickets newest first without overshooting. Verify replay.

An empty round still runs the declared draw process and records history, then settles nothing and schedules the next round. Verify one consumed draw sequence, zero wallet movement and clean rescheduling.
A side bet is admitted only with a positive accepted main stake in command order; cancelling the last main chip cancels all its side chips. Verify main/side ordering and no orphaned wagers.

A command's own stamp (tick time as fallback) must lie in its mode's window [opening, deadline); valid older commands run before closing even on late ticks, while undo needs the current tick before the deadline. Verify equality.

Give the lowest free seat; with a queue, serve FIFO, promoting only in unfunded rounds. Release idle seats after both transport-grace and idle-round limits, on separate clocks, never by gameplay-input age. Funded seats stay. Verify no newcomer bypass.

Before risk starts, withdrawal refunds the original stake (unboard keeps the seat, stand releases it). Debit a replacement before refunding the old stake; a rejected replacement keeps the old. Funded players stay locked until terminal settlement. Verify refund eligibility.

The first accepted stake fixes a room's or market's currency and precision; later stakes must match, and the lock releases only when no open ticket, cash trace or liability remains. Verify cash-out and unboarding do not unlock early.

Admit a stake only if worst-case liability fits every ceiling: sum a player's open maximum gross returns without netting opposite selections and evaluate each outcome across overlapping bets. Reject rather than clip winnings. Verify candidate-inclusive exposure after every change.

State each limit's scope: platform per-chip versus table per-spot accumulated, minimum on every chip or only a spot's first, strictest shared cap, per-product allowances freed on undo. Continuations re-check original and current limits, only tightening. Verify small add-ons.

Stakes (per hand too) and every possible payout must land on the wallet grid, stakes above the minimum, the aggregate debit equal to the sum; reject violations before any RNG draw. Verify rejections consume no randomness.

Auto cash-out targets: absent, null, zero or invalid mean none; otherwise enforce minimum and grid and clamp above the maximum, or take the first discrete rung at or above the target. Verify each case and manual 1.00 exits.

On a fatal tick, discard unpaid same-tick wins, refund each open accepted debit once from tick-entry state, cancel only new queued debits, union all recoverable evidence and exclude proven terminals. Verify no refund-cancel overlap against platform debit identity.

If the authority tick stalls beyond a declared bound, reject new bets and cashouts, void open tickets with full refunds from original state without catch-up draws, and restart the schedule. Verify threshold, empty-room exemption and no stale reopening.

A round keeps the rules it was accepted under: persist rounding policy, targets and delays with it; retired products reject new stakes but honor open tickets; upgrade only wholly legacy states, rejecting mixed shapes. Verify restart survival.

Bound command state: budget ordinary controls per player, round and room bytes; exempt money-carrying commands; never count-evict terminal IDs within a retention epoch, pausing new commands at byte limits. Verify replay protection survives pressure.

Abandonment settles every open round by a declared deterministic policy: bank a legal claim, continue default actions to terminal, accept a pending offer, or close at zero before any action; thresholds are absolute currency. Verify paths across stakes.

Declare per engine whether commands run before or after elapsed-time catch-up and which same-step ending wins (deaths before withdrawals); catch-up advances fixed steps within a budget, keeping fractional time debt. Verify late dispatches and no dropped or duplicated steps.

Judge a manual exit by its original normalized stamp strictly before the bust, clamping payout time to takeoff, current and bust bounds (previous tick if unstamped). At the bust mark aboard bets pending; finalize after grace. Verify late delivery.

Sell only from the caller's named source round, net of its already-listed shares (missing size means the remainder); fill asks ascending, equal asks by age, sized min(budget, listed, holdings), skipping the caller's own. Verify no overselling.

Cancel a pool with fewer than two outcomes holding shares, or one-sided, undersized or without winning stake: refund original stakes (or remaining net pools) without winner allocation, settling from held tickets, not display odds. Verify every branch.

Winners receive stake plus losing pool × round8(stake / winning pool) × (1 − fee), then round8 money; rake applies only to allocated loser funds. Verify principal protection, proportional rounding and residual conservation.

Allocate D atoms by floor(D × weight / total), then give the remaining atoms by descending fractional remainder, ascending key; reuse it for winnings and refunds. Verify the sum equals D and ties are deterministic.

If the distributable pool exceeds cap × winning stake, cap winning tickets and return the surplus to losers proportionally with exact remainders; the house keeps only prior rake. Verify excess ownership, not house retention or a full void.

Quantize each declared intermediate (product, sum, division) at its own stage and direction, then multiply by stake; never one final rounding, or nearest where floor is specified. Published odds never decide eligibility. Verify each stage at minimal stakes.

Declare what each multiplier and cap covers: round raw values before an absolute cap; scatter cash may sit outside both; a capped base cancels pending features, else they finish before the final clamp. Verify per-route totals.

When odds or chance are quantized to a lattice, compute realized RTP from lattice values, not nominal ones; repair quotes that break the target; clip or suspend by declared rule. Verify bounds, strict equality and small stakes.

When part of a probability table becomes ineligible, state where its mass goes: to the plain outcome without renormalizing, or renormalized over eligible entries; sequential tests use conditional rates p/(1−q). Verify unconditional masses and history-dependent probabilities.

Compare the raw integer or unrounded uniform with exact cumulative thresholds, stating inclusive and exclusive endpoints; merge touching intervals; give unmatched tail mass to a declared default; never sample from rounded published probabilities. Verify finite-source endpoint masses.

Declare the wild-run policy: the first ordinary symbol after leading wilds sets the payment, never adding the wild prefix, or the larger pays. All-wild runs pay the wild table or, if declared, each otherwise-unpaid ordinary symbol. Verify no double count.

Scatters terminate line runs without substituting; scatter awards count the original board and add to line wins; a symbol serving as wild and scatter counts as scatter before substitution or expansion. Verify interruption, additive awards and trigger counts.

Connected ways link adjacent reels at row offsets −1, 0, +1; state whether dead-end branches are pruned before counting ways and reading the maximum wild multiplier, and that separated branch groups pay independently. Verify forward-reachable versus pruned fixtures.

Free-game entry and retrigger count only the declared board (initial or terminal, never continuation or nested-respin scatters), using a phase-specific table or per-scatter award; declare priority or additivity of competing features. Verify per phase, count and losing terminal boards.

Choose one weighted ordinary expanding symbol at feature entry and keep it through retriggers; expand every reel containing that actual symbol, never wild substitutes; award separated reels independently. Verify stable identity and awards.

Continuation and bought-entry responses must not report the same winnings twice: state whether each response is cumulative or incremental, and whether entry scatter cash enters both the base and the feature. Verify the wallet credits each amount once.

Gamble feature: only positive ordinary wins may be gambled, bonus wins settle immediately; successes update pending winnings without paying until bank or the configured last gamble, which auto-banks. Verify a round-count horizon independent of stake size.

Draw one independent uniform stop per reel and read consecutive strip positions with wraparound; declare the cascade refill source, such as continuing from the retained strip cursor rather than redrawing cells. Verify joint window frequencies, cursor retention and vacancy order.

State whether conditional tables and landing odds use the original pre-overlay board or the live state: freeze them at pre-respin occupancy, or recompute per empty cell. Verify draw order with several landings, and covered cells.

Sample latent round state (layout, tier, option, model) once at entry, freeze it and condition all later tables on it; later decisions or respins never redraw it. Verify joint dependence and no rerolls.

Keep persistent escalation state apart from a temporary per-spin offset: effective index = min(persistent + offset, top rung), only qualifying events raise the persistent part, and the offset is discarded at spin end. Verify next-spin restoration.

Declare the injection law: per-reel limit (e.g. at most one special), uniform over eligible cells on the initial board, in cascades only into new vacancies on reels without retained specials, action/wave tiers, cutoff wave. Verify retention through gravity.

Fix the conditioning state, then regenerate the whole feature or round without extra stake until the acceptance test passes (zero win, minimum pay, special symbol); sample thresholds once. Verify acceptance above zero, termination and conditioned RTP.

Bounded forcing searches declare their budget and fallback: on exhaustion the normal outcome stands, so real wins can leak through. Verify exclusions, exhaustion frequency, the realized continuation rate and its RTP effect.

Retry from an immutable snapshot: deep-clone entry state per attempt and restore rejected state. Aliased objects let rejected attempts inflate later payouts; chaining rejected results forward changes the law. Verify isolation with mutation tests.

Sample the forcing decision once per decision point with a declared probability schedule (wave base plus threshold bonus, capped), never before the first win. Verify threshold selection, saturation at the cap and absence of pre-win forcing.

Display floor(100·exp(g·t))/100 and schedule the bust at ln(min(C+0.01, cap))/g, so every exit within C's bin is valid; at cap equality aboard loses. Verify 1.00 manual exits and exact bust boundaries.

entries.mechanism: strip sampler：每 reel 独立均匀抽取一个合法 stop，再依 strip 顺序取连续窗口，越过 strip 尾部时循环；不是对可见 cells 独立抽 symbol。
ToTheTop FG 的独占全 wild 补奖：先排除本轮已支付普通 ways 的 symbol，再按左起全 wild 连续 reels 的 wild 数乘积，向每个剩余 symbol 分别支付对应 paytable；两 reel 情形只允许指定最高 symbol。
entries.fingerprintNote: tothetop pays all-wild prefix ways per unpaid symbol using the product of wild counts; two-reel awards are restricted to the top symbol.

entries.mechanism: ToTheTop 自然 base 分别按 coin 数触发 coin feature、按恰好达到 scatter 数触发 FG；两条件并非互斥，两 feature 奖励与 base line win 相加。
entries.fingerprintNote: tothetop evaluates coin-count and exact scatter-count triggers independently and adds both features.

entries.mechanism: ToTheTop FG 的 reel 增高：每个尚未满高 reel 的 growth coin 立即解锁同一 strip window 的下一格并增加一场 FG，新揭露的 growth coin 可以在同一 spin 连续增高；满高后 growth coin 变成 wild，不再加场。
entries.reclassReason: tothetop 的成长币揭示下一位置并在最大高度变百搭，是该游戏独有的特性。

entries.mechanism: ToTheTop stacked FG route 按累计额外授予 FG 数选择下一 spin 的 reel set，而不是按已播放 spin 数、当前中奖次数或固定每 spin 改一次 reel。
entries.reclassReason: tothetop 按累计追加免费旋转数选择堆叠卷轴组，属单款设计。

entries.mechanism: ToTheTop coin feature 的本 reel 落币率在该 reel 的本次 respin 开始按旧 occupancy 固定，同 reel 较早 landing 不改变后续格的概率；Disco 则在扫描每个空格前重新按当前 reel occupancy 计算 rate，形成同 spin 内反馈。 Gold Rush 也使用 Disco 的逐 cell occupancy 更新顺序。
entries.fingerprintNote: tothetop freezes landing odds at pre-respin occupancy; goldDiggers and discodazzle recompute before each empty cell.

entries.mechanism: ToTheTop 与 Maneater 的 FG 最低奖以整段 feature 反复重生成实现（未加新 stake、无 retry budget）；自然/买入可用不同下界；Maneater 自然 FG 到 upper band 还会按概率拒绝并继续同一循环；ToTheTop 某些 variant 在 feature 生成前随机把该下界上调一次。
entries.fingerprintNote: tothetop/maneater regenerate free features until route-specific minimum-pay and upper-band tests pass.

entries.mechanism: ToTheTop 部分普通 RTP variant 先按独立概率选择 whole-round zero-win 条件，再不断重新生成完整 main round（含 FG/coin feature）直到 round.win 为零；该路由不追加 stake。
entries.fingerprintNote: tothetop samples the forced-zero decision once and regenerates complete main rounds until total winnings are zero.

entries.mechanism: Maneater 在 trigger spin 的指定 reels 上只有 stack 起点位于指定边时才抽对应 local jackpot；每符合 reel 单独抽一次、中奖支付配置 fixed jackpot×inner stake，respin 和 FG 不再抽这个 local jackpot。
entries.reclassReason: maneater 触发旋转上的局部大奖抽取是该游戏独有。

entries.mechanism: Maneater conversion 先按 eligible symbol 总数与 stack count/phase 抽要转换的数量，再无放回均匀选对应 symbol 位置；base trigger 倍率固定，base respin 与 FG 各自重新抽 baby-wild 倍率。
entries.reclassReason: maneater 的宝宝百搭转换数量与倍数分布是单款特性。

entries.mechanism: Maneater fg300 总买入先在不同 initial-scatter award routes 中等概率抽一个，再按被选 route 生成 feature 与最低奖过滤；直接 fg303/304/305 routes 使用同成本但指定该入口。
entries.reclassReason: maneater fg300 混合购买的入口路线均匀选择是该购买项的专属配置。

entries.mechanism: Disco base 左边 multiplier scatter 与右边 gold collector 同时出现才触发 one-shot：保留所有 coin/special，非 coin 清为空格，按原 coin 数对空格追加 regular coins，先把 regular 值乘左侧倍率，再把所有 regular coin 值一次汇入 gold 并支付；既存 regular 的乘后值带入自然 bonus。
entries.reclassReason: discodazzle 的双边特殊符号、金色清扫与带入奖励的组合流程是该游戏独有。

entries.mechanism: Disco gold 买入先抽固定 entry 的 coin 数/stop vector/coin values，然后保持该 entry 重放整段 bonus 直到至少落过一个 gold collector；普通 disco buy 不执行此条件化。
entries.fingerprintNote: discodazzle gold buys sample entry count, stops and values once and retry the bonus until a gold lands; ordinary buys do not condition on gold.

entries.mechanism: Book/Chili 的前导 wild 后出现普通符号时，以该普通符号支付整条连续 run；不会再比较较短 pure-wild 前缀的支付；整条仅 wild 时才以 wild 支付。
entries.fingerprintNote: bookOfDead, burningChili and the Nudge lines pay the wild table only for an entirely wild run.

entries.mechanism: Gold 的 Nugget Collect 以 reel-5 Collector 与至少一枚原始 Nugget 共现触发；不要求 reel-1 Multiplier 共现。
entries.reclassReason: goldDiggers 的 Nugget Collect 触发条件是该游戏独有。

entries.mechanism: Nugget Collect 保留 Nugget/初始 specials，清除其余 cells；每个 empty cell 只重抽一次 Nugget landing，landing odds 以原始 Nugget 数量索引并向末项饱和，不随本次新 coin 递增。
entries.fingerprintNote: goldDiggers tests each blank once with original nugget-count odds saturated at the last entry.

entries.mechanism: Nugget Collect 的可选初始 Multiplier 只乘所有 regular Nugget values；Collector 取 regular 总和并支付一份，line win 另加，Collector 自身不再加入 coin 池。
entries.reclassReason: goldDiggers 收集者对普通金块求和、仅在初始乘数存在时相乘；math-hold-and-win 第 3 步已教收集者优先级与求和，余为该游戏参数。

entries.mechanism: Gold/Disco bonus entry 仅 regular coins 紧密装入各 reel 底部，初始可玩窗口外每枚 entry coin 再解锁一格；以后每枚新 coin 在本轮 landing 完毕后解锁本 reel 一格，effect/payment 后 coins 再紧密下落，下一 respin 才能使用新开空格。
entries.reclassReason: goldDiggers/discodazzle 的入口高度解锁细则；math-hold-and-win 第 2 步已教“解锁在落点之后、下一次重转可用”。

entries.mechanism: Gold/Disco 同 bonus respin 生成特殊币的限制：落过 multiplier/gold 后清零其后对应 type 权重；每 reel silver 也有生成限制，Gold 用显式 null 检查、Disco 用 row truthiness（row zero 不能阻止后续 silver）；Gold 无可用 type 权重时 fallback regular。
entries.reclassReason: goldDiggers 与 discodazzle 对后续倍数/金色类型的抑制及空值守卫差异是两款遗留实现的怪癖。

entries.mechanism: Gold/Disco bonus Multiplier coin 将全部已有/新 coin values 乘 m，随后自身 value 恢复为 m 而非 m²；它自身的 m 也进入终盘支付。
entries.reclassReason: 乘数币自身取值重置为 m 而非 m² 的语义是 goldDiggers/discodazzle 的币设计。

entries.mechanism: Gold/Disco bonus Gold collector 由初值零复制全盘 coin 总和，Silver 由初值零复制本 reel 总和；sources 不消耗，copy 另留 board，special 下一轮转 regular 后保留值并能再被放大/收集；Disco row-zero skip 另有已教条目。
entries.reclassReason: Gold/Silver 复制整盘或整轴和的规则是 goldDiggers/discodazzle 的特殊币设计。

entries.mechanism: Gold 买入先抽 entry Nugget count，再按 count 条件抽全三枚 Nugget-stack reels 的 pattern；每 reel 从合法 stack/blank stop 列表均匀抽 stop，value 按 main base weights；entry 不支付 line/collection。
entries.reclassReason: goldDiggers 购买的入口币数与堆叠轴联合分布是该购买项的专属设计。

entries.mechanism: goldBonus 固定一份已抽 entry board，整段 Gold Rush 重抽直到至少出现一枚 Gold，最多固定 attempts；bonus 不重抽；exhaustion 返回最后一次即使无 Gold。
entries.fingerprintNote: goldDiggers retries the gold bonus within a fixed attempt budget and returns the last attempt on exhaustion.

entries.mechanism: Book 的同一 Book 符号既作为 line wild 替代普通符号，也按原始全盘数量付 scatter 奖并触发/retrigger feature；line 与 scatter 奖金分别累加。
entries.fingerprintNote: bookOfDead's Book is both line wild and original-board scatter.

entries.mechanism: Book 原盘 Scatter 达 threshold 进入一组免费 spins；FG 中再次达 threshold 增加同组 rounds；免费轮使用独立 fg strip 而非 base strip。
entries.fingerprintNote: bookOfDead: free-spin scatters add rounds to the same group and use the free-game strips.

entries.mechanism: Book 免费 spins 开始前按 weights 只选一次 ordinary symbol，整段含 retriggers 使用同一 expansion identity；每轮该 symbol 所在 reel 全高变成该 symbol，Book wild 不替代它触发 expansion。
Burning Scatter 不替代普通 line，遇到即截断 line；全盘 Scatter 按 count 给一笔额外 scatter pay，line 与 scatter 合计，未触发免费或 coin game。
entries.fingerprintNote: burningChili scatters add cash but trigger no feature.

entries.mechanism: Disco96 gold 买入的无 Gold 重试不重新复制 seed coin 对象：失败 feature 内 multiplier 对 seed regular values 的修改留到下次尝试，下一次 accepted feature 的付款因此依赖先前被拒绝路径。
entries.fingerprintNote: discodazzle96 retries alias entry token objects, so rejected multipliers raise later accepted payouts.

entries.mechanism: 每个动作使用对应的 private reel strip；各 reel 独立抽取 stop，并按 strip 循环取连续窗口；respin 切换到对应 Respin strip。
entries.fingerprintNote: fruitNudge/sheriffNudge select private strips by action and switch to respin strips.

entries.mechanism: payline 的第一个普通 paying symbol 固定 winningSymbol，前后 wild 均作为该 symbol 延长 run；只有整段为 wild 时才按 WILD paytable 付款，不另比较或支付较短纯 wild 前缀。
只有 gold wild 进入保留板并参与 feature 触发：多个 gold wild 达到触发条件，或 gold wild 与 ARROW 同盘即触发；normal wild 既不保留也不计入该组合触发。
entries.reclassReason: fruitNudge/sheriffNudge 只留存和计数金色百搭的角色规则属该特性设计。

entries.mechanism: trigger spin 上 normal/gold wild 的 multiplier 均为 1；只有后续 respin 新落且未被保留 wild 覆盖的 gold wild 才按当前 mode 和 totalPaylines 抽 multiplier，随后保留该值；normal wild 始终为 1。
entries.reclassReason: Nudge 系列金色百搭倍数仅在新出现且未被覆盖时抽取的细则属单家族设计。

entries.mechanism: ARROW 不改变当前付款盘：它将每一 reel 的保留 gold wild 按原垂直顺序紧密排列到该 reel 顶部，保留各自 multiplier，作为下一 respin 保留板；没有保留 gold wild 时 ARROW 不会产生该 reset。
entries.reclassReason: ARROW 把留存金色百搭压到卷轴顶部是 Nudge 系列特性；math-moving-wild-collection 第 3 步已教 Nudge 的次序。

entries.mechanism: fruitNudge100k 的低 stake main20/main40 在 organic generator 之前额外抽一次稀有分支；命中即返回按 stake 缩放 WIN_FIELDS 指定的金额字段的预存 max-win 轨迹并支付 floor，绕过当轮 reel/feature 生成及 organic cap rejection。
payline 明细逐条 normalize 后舍入；权威 totalPaylineWin 则先加未归一化 lineWin，再以 inner bet / totalPaylines 归一化并整体舍入，而非加明细舍入值。respin 按该盘权威金额累计，whole-round 再舍入/封顶，因此明细之和未必等于实付。
entries.fingerprintNote: fruitNudge/sheriffNudge round each line descriptor separately but round the authoritative payment once from the raw sum.

entries.mechanism: 每卷独立均匀抽取本卷 strip stop，再按同一 stop 取循环连续窗口；strip 内符号因连续窗口相关，而非逐格独立抽样。前两卷居中对齐共同坐标，卷面 sizes 属配置。
连通评估以相邻卷同一行或上下相邻一行连接：第 1 卷仅要求右邻，第 2 卷要求左右邻，此后只要求已连通左邻；Bar/Treasure 分支不做 backward-prune，不能通往最末支付卷的早期分支仍进入每卷计数乘积和最高 wild 选择。
entries.fingerprintNote: barValhalla/treasureHunter keep forward dead-end branches when multiplying counts and selecting the maximum wild.

entries.mechanism: 跨相邻卷只允许同排及上下相邻排连接；当前两卷上、下分支均存在，且前三卷中间行断开时，从两个起点分别扩展两个 connected group；每组独立算长度、ways 乘积和最高 wild，再相加，后段共享位置仍可分别属于两组。Bar/Treasure 不剪枝，Piggy 分组后剪枝，另列差异。
entries.fingerprintNote: barValhalla/treasureHunter leave groups unpruned; piggyBank prunes them.

entries.mechanism: 纯 wild 连通组仍在每个普通支付符号的循环中替代并分别支付各自 paytable；allWildSubstituted 仅记为 metadata，不抑制重复符号奖，也不另按 WILD paytable 单独结算。
entries.fingerprintNote: barValhalla/piggyBank: allWildSubstituted is metadata and adds no separate wild award.

entries.mechanism: 每个 coin 的价值表由其所在原始 strip 窗口是否恰有一个 coin 决定；同卷多 coin 切换 stacked table。此判定发生在 retained-wild 覆盖前，覆盖 coin 虽不收集仍影响本卷价值分布。
entries.fingerprintNote: barValhalla/piggyBank choose singleton or stacked value tables from the original strip-window count; covered tokens affect sampling but not collection.

entries.mechanism: moving refill 时，若该卷任意位置已有 retained wild，该卷所有新 strip WILD 的类型都强制 normal；仅完全无 retained wild 的卷才随机成为新 gold，且被 retained 位置覆盖的 landing 不计新 arrival。
entries.reclassReason: barValhalla/piggyBank 的整轴抑制新百搭规则属该移动百搭家族的设计。

entries.mechanism: moving 新 wild 的类型权重表按 action/当前 feature spin 选择并在最后行饱和；当次新 gold 使用进入该 respin 前的 future-tier index。每个含新 gold 的 respin 结算后，只把未来新 gold 的 multiplier index 升一档至 tier cap；多个同次 arrival 不累计多档，既有 gold 倍数不升级。
entries.fingerprintNote: barValhalla/piggyBank: arrivals use the pre-respin tier and any new-gold spin advances it once for future arrivals only.

entries.mechanism: moving feature 每次重开初始 horizon、retained board 和 future-tier index；发现新 gold 后按最左新 gold 重设 totalSpins=当前 spin+到最右卷所需移动数。支付到最后 gold 位于最右卷的 respin 后结束，不增加将它移出屏幕的空 cleanup respin。Piggy 仅非 collecting 的 two-gold 入口进入该循环。
entries.reclassReason: 移动百搭特性的视界重置与延伸细则是 barValhalla 家族的实现。

entries.mechanism: random-jump 新 gold 在前两卷各至多采用一个路径；第 1 卷先按 spin-dependent table 选 pattern，第 2 卷反复拒绝同 pattern 和仅末步不同的 paired patterns。逐步取路径目标卷并均匀选目标行；若目标卷未变，拒绝原行，强制 gold 改变格子。
entries.reclassReason: 跳跃路径互斥与目标行抽取细则属 barValhalla/treasureHunter 的特性设计。

entries.mechanism: 两种 selectable free-game 模式的 retrigger law 不同：moving FG 每个 trigger spin 按 scatter reward table 重触发，randomJump FG 只用入口 scatter 的初始 rounds，所有后续 roundReward 固定零；各 round 中 moving/jumping respin 的 scatter 不增加 FG rounds。
entries.fingerprintNote: barValhalla/treasureHunter: moving free games retrigger from each trigger spin's scatter table; random-jump mode keeps only entry rounds.

entries.mechanism: 自然 FG continuation 的 response.win 再次包含 opening state 的 baseGame.winning 加 FG winning，而非只返回未支付增量；opening 已返回该 base win。两个 engine segment 先各自封顶，普通 Bar/Treasure wrapper 仅设置 isMaxWin 而不将组合总额再次 clamp。
entries.fingerprintNote: barValhalla/treasureHunter continuation returns already-reported base winnings again and flags only the combined cap.
entries.question: barValhalla/treasureHunter 的续玩响应再次返回已报告的基础奖金，并分别封顶再只标记合并封顶：平台信用语义是累计还是增量？保留该遗留行为前需核实总负债。

entries.mechanism: 100k 的低 stake organic randomJump FG 在正常 feature 生成之前抽 rare injection gate；命中即使用预置 maxWinJumpingFreeGame 的WIN_FIELDS 指定的金额字段按 innerBet 缩放，直接支付 max(currency floor,cap×innerBet) 并终止，概率另依 opening 是否 boosted 选择。
entries.reclassReason: 100k 版本的低注额保底模板与稀有门抽取是这些版本的专属实现。

entries.mechanism: ordinary ways 先逐 connected group 按 toFixed(2) 舍入再加和；moving coin collection 每个 eligible wild 加入 pool 时 round accumulator，random-jump 每个 collector 先 round 再加；spin 合并 ways/coin 再 round，feature/FG 合并已 round 子奖后再 round 并 cap。Piggy one-shot 先 round coin sweep，然后(ways+coin)×roundMultiplier 再 round；最终 whole round 再 round。
entries.fingerprintNote: barValhalla/treasureHunter/piggyBank keep each title's rounding boundaries; piggyBank rounds its sweep before multiplying.

entries.mechanism: connected 簇的最高 wild 倍数在反向剪枝之前从整个前向可达集合读取；随后剪掉的死路 wild 不再增加 ways 数，但其已读出的高倍数仍参与该簇赔付。
entries.fingerprintNote: piggyBank reads the maximum wild multiplier before backward pruning, so pruned wilds add no ways but keep their multiplier influence.

entries.mechanism: 每个 scatter 按 action 权重分为 diamond 或 key；仅非 FG 的 diamond 另抽 jackpot 触发；每个 diamond 的结果直接覆盖 jackpotTriggered，所以多个 diamond 时以最后一个 diamond 的成功/失败决定是否支付 jackpot；FG 完全禁用该触发。
entries.reclassReason: piggyBank 的钻石/钥匙分类与大奖覆盖标志是该游戏独有。

entries.mechanism: 自然 base/boosted 的 key 达常规门槛时必定进 FG，低 key 数量则按 key count 和 action 专用概率抽神秘 FG；神秘入口使用 lowScatterInitRounds，常规入口按 key-count reward 表；FG 内较低的 key 门槛确定性 retrigger 并按该表加轮。
entries.reclassReason: piggyBank 钥匙阈值、神秘概率与回合数是该游戏的特性参数。

entries.mechanism: random-jump 在最长剩余路径已变为零时，若当前 refill 又落下新 gold wild，强制将 spinsLeft 改为 1，下一 respin 才给该新 gold 分配跳跃路径；此新 arrival 会延长 feature 而非直接进入 cleanup。
entries.reclassReason: 剩余跳跃路径归零时补一次额外重转的处理是该家族的特性细节。

entries.mechanism: AATF/Perseus 的 ways evaluator 对连续全 wild 前缀，为尚未形成实符号 win 的每一种普通 symbol 另算一笔该 symbol 的 paytable 奖励；Perseus 这些 ways 只用于 chest/bomb 判定而非直接现金。
entries.fingerprintNote: allaboutthefish and perseus; perseus uses these ways only for chest and bomb logic.

entries.mechanism: AATF 计算 wild 自身 ways 时每列把 wild 数量加了两次，再乘该 wild paytable；这与普通 symbol 的 symbol+wild count 不同。
entries.reclassReason: allaboutthefish 的百搭自带路数重复计数是遗留实现，条文明确不应当作通用评估器。

entries.mechanism: AATF 的 fork 与 knife wild 合起来或单个双角色 wild 触发收鱼 respin；触发时 initial ways 只记录，不计入现金，实际支付 expanded respin 的 ways 和 fish。
entries.reclassReason: allaboutthefish 的叉加刀角色触发采集是该游戏独有。

entries.mechanism: AATF 收鱼触发优先于 scatter：同一 initial board 若已触发收鱼，即使 scatter 达到自然 FG 门槛也不进入 FG；FG 中同样不发该局 scatter retrigger spins。
entries.fingerprintNote: allaboutthefish: collection takes priority over scatter free-game entry on the same board.

entries.mechanism: AATF 收鱼 respin 冻结前两整列，后面三列重取 strip 并扩高；自然 base 抽 expansion height，FG 每次收鱼令这三列高度增加一级并在后续免费局持续保留至上限。
entries.reclassReason: allaboutthefish 的卷轴增高与跨旋转保留高度是该游戏独有的特性。

entries.mechanism: AATF 鱼面值的抽样表按该列可见窗口恰有一条鱼或多条鱼分流；natural round 起点抽出的 option 同时控制 fish 面值表和 Elvis 入口概率，并传入整个自然 FG，形成共享隐藏状态。
entries.fingerprintNote: allaboutthefish samples the option once; it jointly selects fish-value tables and Elvis-entry odds.

entries.mechanism: AATF Elvis 入口先按 expansion height/option 抽 collector row，再从含 Elvis 的 strip 锚点反推 stop；该入口保证最后一列有 Elvis，natural collection 可先选 ordinary 或 Elvis strip，买 Elvis 则强制该入口。
entries.reclassReason: allaboutthefish 的 Elvis 行条件抽取是该游戏独有。

entries.mechanism: AATF 无 Elvis 的收鱼 respin 直接支付该 expanded board 上全部 fish face×stake，并与该 respin ways 相加；未触发收鱼的普通局不单独支付鱼值。
entries.reclassReason: allaboutthefish 无 Elvis 时的采集鱼面值支付是该游戏独有。

entries.mechanism: AATF natural FG 在完整 feature payout 低于 freeGameMinCap×stake 时无限重生成整个 feature，入口 spin/option 保持；只接受达到下限的 feature。
AATF 买 FG 用一次 uniform draw 选择模拟 3/4/5 scatter 的初始 round 模型；同一个 draw 又控制 low/high payout 的一次 replay，replacement 保留原模型且不再检查。买 Elvis 则重复采样 base 直到 fork+knife 门满足，并固定 option=1。
entries.reclassReason: allaboutthefish 购买复用同一均匀数产生相关性，是单款购买设计。

entries.mechanism: Perseus/Cetus 只有 initial payline win 才开启整列 continuation；每个后续 winning wave 按 wave-dependent weights 在前四列选开槽，槽右侧整列右移、最右列退出，槽内重新填连续三格。
entries.reclassReason: perseus 的插入列与右移丢弃规则是该游戏的特性。

entries.mechanism: Perseus 开槽抽 Regular/Kraken/Chest/Bomb：Kraken 将槽整列替换成 1× wild；Cetus 两个 SKU 仅 Regular/Kraken，整列三个 wild 共享一次 wave-dependent cetus multiplier 抽样，下一 wave 重置旧倍率为 1。
entries.reclassReason: perseus 的槽类型与 cetus 共享倍数是单款设计。

entries.mechanism: Perseus Chest 先填一列普通 strip，再随机覆盖一格 1× chest wild；对所有非 pure-wild ways wins，按每种 win 的 non-wild 可见格数查 chestValues 并累加，即使 receiver 不在该 win 中；pure-wild fallback 不收增量。
entries.reclassReason: perseus 宝箱百搭按非百搭可见格增值是单款特性。

entries.mechanism: Perseus Bomb 先用 strip 填槽并随机放一个 bomb wild；ways 判断赢格后保留全部赢格，炸掉其他格、压实保留格并按列 strip 补空；槽中 object wild 转普通 wild，最后重新计算 paylines 才付钱。
entries.reclassReason: perseus 炸弹的保留、移除与补充流程是单款特性。

entries.mechanism: Perseus/Cetus 的 forceNonWin 门使开槽仅可选前两列并强制 Regular；若余下前三区两列均有 wild，则放弃强制；否则至多 strip.length 次找不含保留列普通符号及 wild 的连续三格，失败 fallback 一次正常 spin。
entries.fingerprintNote: perseus ForceNonWin restricts slots to the first two reels and Regular, skips forcing when both retained reels hold wilds.

entries.mechanism: Perseus FG 根据触发 3/4/5 scatter 数抽一份可用角色组合：5 scatter 强制全角色；后续 initial board 的 4/5 scatter 可从单角色升级到双/全角色，并永久改变后续 wave 的角色概率表。
entries.reclassReason: perseus 按入口 scatter 数选择可用角色并永久升级是单款设计。

entries.mechanism: Perseus/Cetus 自然 FG 门只看被接受的 initial base board 的 scatter；FG initial board 的 scatter 独立增加 unmultiplied scatter cash 和 retrigger spins，continuation 新生成 scatter 不另触发；FG 初始 round 数是按 action/entry scatter 加权抽样。
entries.fingerprintNote: perseus/cetus: only accepted initial boards trigger or retrigger; scatter cash is unmultiplied.

entries.mechanism: cetusOnly 与 perseusCetusOnly 买 FG 同一 entry scatter cash 计入 synthetic base.win 后，又被 loadFreeGames 放进 freeGame.winning，最终两者相加；natural FG 则仅 feature 入口计一次。
entries.fingerprintNote: cetusOnly bought entries add scatter cash to the synthetic base and again inside free-game winnings.

entries.mechanism: 按每列 strip 长度独立均匀抽 stop，再沿 strip 连续取可见窗口并循环回绕；列内可见符号相关，不能按每格独立 weighted draw 替代。
Perseus/Cetus 买 FG 的 entry scatter cash 在 feature cap 之外另外相加：loadFreeGames 收到 baseGameWin=0，feature 可付满 cap，wrapper 再加 entry scatterPay 且不做 whole-round 再截断。
entries.fingerprintNote: perseus/cetus buys cap the feature with base zero and add entry scatter cash outside the cap, so totals can exceed it.

entries.mechanism: landing jackpot 的 coin 后续 progression 起点重置为 coinValue 数组的最低普通值：level 0 付 jackpot，下一成功 level 付最低值之后一级，而非从 jackpot 金额或另抽面值续升。
entries.reclassReason: cowAbduction 落地大奖后的阶梯重置是单款特性。

entries.mechanism: base scatter 数只作为独立 Bernoulli FG trigger 的概率索引，可由不足传统 3-scatter 数触发；显示的 scatterLevel 由本轮 trigger/cosmetic draw 得到，不跨轮影响真实触发。
entries.reclassReason: cowAbduction 基础免费游戏伯努利按实际 scatter 数索引属单款调参，scatterLevel 只是显示。

entries.mechanism: 买 coin feature 先按权重选 forced coin 数，再均匀选不同列（两枚时抽排除列、一枚时抽保留列），在每个被选列均匀选一行覆盖成 coin；其余 strip 仍正常参与 ways/wild，scatter 对此 bought spin 不触发 FG。
entries.reclassReason: cowAbduction 购买金币特性的放置规律是单款设计。

entries.mechanism: 按三列各自 strip 长度独立均匀抽 stop，再连续取共享 height 的窗口并循环回绕；列内可见格不是独立 symbol draws。
每个 Cow FG initial board 的 scatter 都增加一个 free spin：取本局 scatterCount 作为新授予数量，不要求成组 scatter，也不使用 base 的 Bernoulli trigger。
entries.fingerprintNote: cowAbduction: every scatter on a free-game initial board awards one extra spin, no grouped threshold or base Bernoulli gate.

entries.mechanism: 每 reel 独立均匀抽 strip stop，读取循环连续窗口作为 initial board；tumble refill 沿接受的 nextIndex 连续推进并 wrap，而不是每格独立重抽普通符号。
entries.fingerprintNote: gates, sweetyTreaty and tartarus refill vacancies by advancing accepted nextIndex cursors.

entries.mechanism: Tartarus/Medusa/Zeus 开局每 reel 可均匀选一个位置注入 model 指定 wild/scatter；Sweety Treaty base 开局仅有 scatter injection，FG 开局才可注入 wild；tumble 仅替换本波新补 vacant，留存 special 的 reel 不再注入，tier 随 action/wave 选定。
entries.fingerprintNote: sweetyTreaty/tartarus inject a mode-eligible wild or scatter; eligibility differs between base and free games.

entries.mechanism: Sweety Treaty base 每波为各 reel 宣告 multiplier，只有本波实际注入 wild 的 reel 激活；本 wave 奖乘 active values 之和，无 active 为 1；首个 base wave 不激活 multiplier。
entries.reclassReason: sweetyTreaty 逐波百搭倍数公告规则是单款特性。

entries.mechanism: latent forced-dead model 保留已抽 model/action，反复生成 opening board 直到 OAK cash win 为零，再接收该 board 的 scatter；opening rejection 没有 fixed retry budget。
entries.fingerprintNote: tartarus/medusa keep model and action fixed and redraw opening boards until OAK cash is zero, with no retry budget.

entries.mechanism: Rush latent branch 二次抽 featureModel 与较高 multiplier 起档；FG 在 persistent floor 上叠加临时 offset 后当前 spin 逐 winning wave 上升，临时跳档不写回跨 spin floor。
entries.fingerprintNote: tartarus/medusa Rush resamples its latent model and start offset each spin.

entries.mechanism: Rush FG 的 terminal scatter 达条件后 persistent 起档只升一档并封顶，供下一 spin 使用；当前 spin 已付奖及临时 Rush 起档不重算，scatter 可另行 retrigger。
entries.fingerprintNote: Qualifying terminal scatters raise the persistent starting index once for the next spin without repricing current wins.

entries.mechanism: Chase 每个 positive winning wave 先按当前档付款，再检查 pre-downgrade wild：Tartarus/Medusa 要对应 FG 的确切 tier，Zeus 允许对应或更高 tier，bronze 允许任意 wild；无论几枚 qualifying wild 都只升一档并跨 spin 保留。
entries.reclassReason: Chase 档位的精确/至少规则按游戏不同，属 tartarus/medusa/zeus 家族内调参。

entries.mechanism: Chase 内嵌 Rush 用 min(persistent index + temporary offset, ladder end)；qualifying wild 后 persistent index 加一，再重算 temporary index；spin 结束丢弃 offset，不按 waveCount 自动爬档。
entries.fingerprintNote: Chase-Rush recomputes the temporary index and has no wave-count-driven upgrades.

entries.mechanism: FG 条件 model law：Rush 的 model odds 按 initial scatter count 选行，Chase 按 current persistent multiplier index 选行；boosted 六-scatter entry 另启专用 model odds 和 wild-injection probability。
entries.reclassReason: 按入口 scatter 数与持久索引选择模型概率表是该家族内部调参。

entries.mechanism: Chase 才另付 trigger scatter cash 和每个 FG spin 的 terminal scatter cash；scatter cash 在 wave ladder 奖之外添加，不乘 wave multiplier；Rush 不获得这些 scatter cash。
entries.fingerprintNote: tartarus/medusa Chase adds trigger and terminal scatter cash outside the wave ladder; Rush pays neither.

entries.mechanism: Medusa regular/super scatter 合计触发 entry，super count 另决定 Rush/Chase 初始 persistent ladder index；只有 base/boost scatter injection 抽 super 类型，FG injection 仅 regular；superfg3 buy 固定四 entry scatter、三个 super 并直接开放 Rush。
entries.reclassReason: medusa 的普通与超级 scatter 合并计数规则是单款特性。

entries.mechanism: Zeus cascade-stop/pre-top-rung kill 仅在 guard armed 且 refill 有奖时抽 rejection；先命中一个 guard 后不再抽另一个；从同一 accepted gravity 继续推进 cursor，有限次寻找真实 dead board，耗尽仍保留真实中奖并继续 cascade。
entries.fingerprintNote: zeus samples armed guards only on winning refills, short-circuits after the first hit and keeps real wins after exhaustion.

entries.mechanism: Blood Moon 新格先抽 scatter；未中 scatter 才以 unconditional orb probability / (1 - scatterChance) 的 conditional rate 抽 FG-only orb并限界，剩余抽 ordinary weighted symbol；base 永不生成 orb。
entries.fingerprintNote: bloodMoonRising tests scatter first, then the orb at orbChance / (1 - scatterChance); base forbids orbs.

entries.mechanism: Blood Moon super buy 先按 scale 增加 orb landing chance；orb value 从满足最低倍率的原 ladder 项中过滤并按保留权重重新归一化抽取，不能直接将低倍率 outcome 钳为最低值。
entries.fingerprintNote: bloodMoonRising super buys scale orb probability and renormalize retained weights over minimum-eligible ladder entries.

entries.mechanism: Tartarus Stream 自然 continuation 将整个 capped base + chosen feature 再作为 response.win 返回，opening 已付 base，但 continuation 没有减去已付 base。
entries.fingerprintNote: tartarusStream stores the capped base-plus-feature total as the continuation win after the opening already returned the base.
entries.question: tartarusStream 把封顶后的 base+feature 存为续玩赢额，而开局已返回 base：钱包按累计还是增量入账？

entries.mechanism: Tartarus/Zeus 的 pickModel 按原表累计和与 uint32 / 2^32 作 <= 比较，不重新归一化；随机数落在表尾剩余质量则返回 index 0，把 residual mass 分配给第一个 model。当前 base 表确实留有非零尾部质量。
entries.fingerprintNote: tartarus/zeus compare uint32 / 2^32 with the original cumulative model table using <=, tail mass goes to model zero.

entries.mechanism: 逐列加权抽 symbol，再加权抽 stack 长度并截断到剩余格数；下一个 stack 必须与上一 stack 不同，refill 的首 stack 也必须不同于空格前的 retained symbol；按 wave 取权重，超过数组时沿用末组。
entries.reclassReason: sugarRush 家族的堆叠长度与相邻排除抽样器是该家族的专属实现。

entries.mechanism: 普通符号盘填完后按列独立检验 scatter，再在该列均匀选一格覆盖，所以初始盘每列最多一个；cascade 保留已有 scatter，仅在该列有新 refill 格且无 retained scatter 时，从新格中选一格覆盖。
SugarRush 按 base cascade 终盘 scatter 总数达到门槛自然启动 FG，scatter 本身不支付；FG 同样以每 spin 终盘 scatter 总数查 retrigger reward，未达到门槛的配置奖励为零。
entries.fingerprintNote: sugarRush counts terminal-board scatters; losing terminal boards still count; counts reset each spin.

entries.mechanism: Scatter meter 到 MAX 即触发（一个/两个 scatter 也可触发）；自然入场按 max(actualScatterCount,3) 查初始 FG 奖励，FG 再触发则只在 meter 到 MAX 时按 actualScatterCount 查 reward，达到 MAX 后不再抽 meter transition。
entries.reclassReason: MAX 计量表触发入口的规则是 sweetyCluster 家族独有。

entries.mechanism: FG 的下一 cascade 使用按 wave 取值的 dead-spin 基础概率，加上 persistent grid 最大值满足的最后一个 threshold bonus，取上限后抽一次决定是否进入强制 dead-refill；这个 gate 在赢波之后才执行。
entries.fingerprintNote: sugarRush/sweetyCluster/candyCash combine wave-indexed dead probability with the last satisfied maximum-grid threshold bonus.

entries.mechanism: Sweety/Candy/Wolf 强制 dead-refill 若 survivors 已能中奖则直接 normal fill；否则从同一 accepted gravity 快照，用单格 stack 重试至无收益；有限预算耗尽改用 normal stack fill；Wolf 每个 rejected attempt 的 column surge 也回滚，仅采用 accepted attempt grid。
entries.fingerprintNote: sweetyCluster/candyCash/riseOfTheWolf retry single-cell dead refills from one accepted gravity snapshot and restore rejected surge state.

entries.mechanism: SugarRush 强制 dead-refill 没有固定原 gravity 快照或 retry budget：每次 rejected winning 候选都把其删除获胜符号后的 gravity 交给下次候选，直到无收益；中间候选不累计支付，也不把其 updated grid 作为新的 persistent grid。
entries.fingerprintNote: sugarRush chains rejected winning candidates through post-removal gravity without a budget; measure termination.

entries.mechanism: 金额上限按阶段生效：base cascade 完整生成后 clamp 基础奖；若基础已 cap 则直接返回并取消待启动 FG；FG 即使累计奖金已 cap 仍完成全部 pending/追加 spin，最后才 clamp feature，再 clamp base+feature 整轮金额。
entries.fingerprintNote: sugarRush/sweetyCluster/candyCash cancel pending free games when the base reaches the cap.

entries.mechanism: 初始盘和补格按加权符号、加权堆叠长度逐段生成；相邻堆叠禁止同符号，补格首段也禁止与存留边界符号相同，长度被剩余格数截短。
Scatter 按列概率覆盖：初始盘每列最多一个；cascade 只有存在新补格且该列没有存留 scatter 才能覆盖一个随机新补格。存留 scatter 保持并随 gravity 移动；模型的 scatterMaxWave 会关闭后续波的覆盖。
entries.fingerprintNote: metaStrike injects scatters and scatterMaxWave disables later injection.

entries.mechanism: Scatter 无随机升级 meter：本次基础 spin 或免费 round 的当前盘总 scatter 达阈值即激活，最终总数索引免费局奖励表；终止的无奖盘同样可触发或再触发，下一免费 round 重新计数。
entries.fingerprintNote: metaStrike activates at a threshold count with no random meter, using the final-board count.

entries.mechanism: 新方块先按波抽数量，再只从当前没有方块的坐标中均匀不放回抽位置，并按剩余可用坐标截短；可落在 scatter 上，不能重复占同一 overlay 坐标。
entries.reclassReason: metaStrike 覆盖方块抽取是单款特性。

entries.mechanism: 炸弹引爆其列内全部方块；每个中心产生自身及上下左右各一格的十字 footprint，排除越界和 scatter 并合并重复格。只消耗真正被炸弹选中的方块，footprint 波及但未被选中的其它方块仍存留。
entries.reclassReason: metaStrike 炸弹十字范围并集是单款特性。

entries.mechanism: 预抽爆炸配额后，每次成功的 detonation event 只消耗一个配额单位，即使同时引爆多个方块；无爆炸尝试不消耗，配额耗尽后可仍发生自然爆炸。
entries.reclassReason: metaStrike 爆炸配额按事件消耗是单款特性。

entries.mechanism: 金额上限分阶段生效：基础 cascade 完整生成后截断基础奖，若基础已达上限则直接结束并不再启动已触发免费局；免费局即使累计奖已达上限也执行全部 pending/追加局，再截断 feature 奖；最终基础加 feature 再受整轮上限约束。
coins 按每列均匀 stop 抽取环绕连续三格，落到普通币或特殊币再按阶段的权重表抽金额；同列格子来自同一 strip window，并非独立抽格。
entries.fingerprintNote: coins samples each reel window from one stop, then draws values with the active phase table.

entries.mechanism: coins 的 payline 实际只接受全 Wild，或恰好一个非 Wild 且无 Coin 的三格线；nonWildSymbols 是保留重复项的数组，因此普通同符三连和一 Wild 加两普通同符均不支付。
entries.reclassReason: coins 三格线的百搭规则是该游戏独有的线型。

entries.mechanism: coins 只有总 Coin 数达到触发门槛且至少含一个特殊收集币才进入 feature；普通币单独满足数量仍不触发，触发时保留并首先收集该 triggering board。
entries.reclassReason: coins 的进入条件与首次收集是该游戏的特性。

entries.mechanism: coins 通常任何新普通币或特殊币都会把剩余 respins 重设；达到总 horizon 的最后三次后，无论是否落新币都只递减，仍正常抽币并收集，不是强制空转；到 counter 耗尽或总 horizon 停止。
entries.reclassReason: coins 最后三回合不重置的重转规则是单款设计。

entries.mechanism: CoinUp 跨 paid main 只携带固定 Sticky Coin 坐标；拒绝重复、越界、超上限及完整 middle row。未触发时按固定遍历顺序填空格，一达到 sticky 上限即移除后续抽表的 sticky 项；若 middle row 意外填满，均匀删一个本轮新格，并同时撤销其 sticky carry。触发后和购买后不输出 carry。
entries.reclassReason: coinUp 粘性币携带与修复规则是单款设计。

entries.mechanism: CoinUp natural bonus 初板仅包含已携带 Sticky 与强制填满的 middle row，其他未 carry 的格均为空；buy 的初板清空 carry 并从各自 start 表强制 middle row。初板上的每个 collector 随即收集，随后才进入 bonus。
entries.reclassReason: coinUp 自然进入携带与购买丢弃携带是单款设计。

entries.mechanism: CoinUp 进入 bonus 时只抽一次 hidden tier，此后整个 feature 的所有空格 landing 与 UP-row 抽取一直使用这一 tier 的两个表，不能每次 respin 或每格重抽 tier。
entries.fingerprintNote: coinUp samples its hidden tier once at bonus entry for landing and UP tables.

entries.mechanism: CoinUp collector 只在初板出现或本轮新落下时收集一次：把所有其他非 collector 格当时的 value × mult 求和写入自身 value，不反复更新旧 collector；该 sweep 在本轮 UP 前完成，collector 自身 mult 留到最终付款再乘。
entries.reclassReason: coinUp 新出现的收集者先于 UP 求和一次；math-hold-and-win 第 3 步已教 landings→collectors→UP 与收集排除规则。

entries.mechanism: CoinUp Multi UP 在该列本轮 landings/collectors 完成后，给当前所有非空格永久增加 multiUpStep，包括刚落的 coin、collector、jackpot、未开 mystery；空格不预存 multiplier，之后落下的新格仍从 1 开始。
entries.reclassReason: coinUp 的 Multi UP 永久加值是该游戏独有的升级机制。

entries.mechanism: CoinUp Coin UP 只升级该列当前 coin 格一阶，重新把 coin value 设为新 level；顶级 Sticky Coin 的下一次升级转成零值 mysteryJackpot，同时保留 mult。Jackpot、collector 和 mystery 不会被 Coin UP 升级。
entries.reclassReason: coinUp 的升级与神秘大奖转换是单款特性。

entries.mechanism: CoinUp buySuperBonus 每轮先照常抽三个 UP；若未抽出任何 multiUp，则从 none 的列中均匀挑一列替成 multiUp；若三列全是 coinUp，则从所有列均匀挑一列替换。已有 multiUp 时不额外添加。
entries.reclassReason: coinUp 超级奖励的 Multi UP 修复是单款特性。

entries.mechanism: CoinUp bonus 结束才逐格开启 mystery：mysteryJackpot 只抽固定 jackpot 类型，普通 mystery 使用可含普通 coin、jackpot 或 collector 的独立 reveal 表；全部保留原格 mult，新揭示 collector 在全部揭示后再收集。
entries.reclassReason: coinUp 的神秘币在奖励结束时揭示并在批次后收集，属该游戏流程；第 3 步已教终局神秘币先于支付。

entries.mechanism: CoinUp mystery 揭成 collector 时，收集 pool 排除所有原本为 mystery/mysteryJackpot 的坐标，即使其现已揭成普通 coin 或 jackpot；也排除其他 collector。因此不会收集同一终局 reveal 批次的奖励。
entries.reclassReason: coinUp 神秘币揭示后的收集者排除规则；math-hold-and-win 第 3 步已教 collectInto 排除其他收集者与指定神秘格。

entries.mechanism: Bars 每格 multiplier/count 先量化，所选倍率合计再量化，最后 bet×合计再次量化；不是只对 bet×原始 reward 合计/count 舍入一次。
entries.fingerprintNote: bars: toFixed(12) per tile multiplier and count, then toFixed(8) for the sum and the stake product.

entries.mechanism: Hotdeck normal 抽一个均匀 strip stop，highRisk 独立有放回抽多个 stop；只有每个 drawn color 都等于选定 pick 才支付一次，否则支付零。
entries.reclassReason: hotdeck 高风险模式的多停点全匹配规则是单款玩法。

entries.mechanism: PrimeDice 以互不重叠区间宽度之和计价，区间接触同一端点允许；实际未舍入 uniform roll 落入任一闭区间即中奖，区间外为零。
entries.fingerprintNote: primedice prices the closed union of non-overlapping intervals against the raw roll.

entries.mechanism: PrimeDice 先量化总区间宽度，再量化 targetRTP×100/chance 的报价倍率并施加 cap，最终中奖金额再次量化；显示 result 的量化不参与中奖判断。
entries.fingerprintNote: primedice: toFixed(8) for total width, targetRTP x 100 / chance before the multiplier cap, and winning stake x multiplier.

entries.mechanism: RingOfFortune 接受 component stake 总和与 charged bet 在绝对容差内不相等的下注，随后仍按未重新归一化的 winning-color stake 付款。
entries.reclassReason: ringOfFortune 的 0.01 容差分配接受与未归一化派彩是遗留怪癖，且存疑。
entries.question: ringOfFortune 接受分配和与实收注额相差 0.01 以内，并按未归一化的分配派彩：不匹配会让 RTP 随注额变化。是遗留行为还是有意设计？采用前需核实。

entries.mechanism: Tarot 先对 gold×silver1×silver2 的倍率乘积作最近舍入，再对 bet×该已量化倍率作第二次最近舍入；不是只量化最后金额。
entries.fingerprintNote: tarot: toFixed(8) of the three-card product, then again for stake x result.

entries.mechanism: CircuitSnap 必须从 power 相邻格起步，路径在 grid 内正交相邻且不重复，终点为 bulb，首 bulb 前及两 bulb 间必须有 rod，并遵守 rod/bulb 上限；服务端由合法 path 导出 prefix rod counts，不能信 client pattern。
entries.reclassReason: circuitSnap 的路径合法性与杆数规则是单款玩法，没有跨游戏规律。

entries.mechanism: Deck52行列同时完成时按completedRows×rowPayout + completedColumns×colPayout相加，同一格可同时支持行奖和列奖；不是取最大一项或单线付款。
entries.reclassReason: deck52 行与列同时完成的叠加奖励是单款计分。

entries.mechanism: HIT Draw cash在抽样前检查每一个潜在结果：下注必须使倍率乘法可精确整除，所得win须整除currencyUnit且不超过maxExposure；任一个结果不满足便拒绝整笔开包，不能先抽后舍入或压cap。
entries.fingerprintNote: hitDraw requires stake x multiplier to divide exactly for every possible outcome and stay within exposure.

entries.mechanism: 实物奖数量采用两阶段不同舍入：先referenceMicroUsd=halfUp(stakeMicroUsd×referenceValueMultiplierPpm/PPM)，再quantityNanograms=floor(referenceMicroUsd×10^9/lockedAskMicroUsdPerGram)；纯度单独记录，不进入这个数量公式。
entries.fingerprintNote: hitDraw: half-up microUSD, then floor to nanograms at the locked ask price; purity recorded separately.

entries.mechanism: Plinko只有risk=insane才启用随机ball multiplier并消费第二次draw；low/medium/high固定ball=1、仅消费bucket draw。
entries.reclassReason: plinko 仅 insane 风险额外消耗一次随机数是单款 RNG 约定。

entries.mechanism: legacy crash autobet返回首项wins[0]作为绝对win，代码未乘bet；因此合法不同下注得到相同货币返回，声明maxWin也直接作用在wins数值上。
entries.reclassReason: crash 遗留 autobet 按绝对封顶金额返回，是遗留实现怪癖，且存疑。
entries.question: crash 遗留 autobet 把 wins[0] 当作封顶后的绝对金额而不乘注额：转用倍数定价公式前需核实注额缩放与实测 RTP。

entries.mechanism: RPS autobet用pattern长度作为结算期限，只要没有loss就付最后currentPayout；首tie建立T×bet，因此短于最大hand数的全tie pattern也能立即得到T×bet。
entries.reclassReason: rockPaperScissors 自动下注的平局与终止规则是单款玩法。

entries.mechanism: Moles每轮重新均匀抽k个不同目标洞，选择洞在molePositions中才算hit和生存，概率k/7；不是避免目标。
entries.reclassReason: moles 的 k/7 成功率是单款玩法。

entries.mechanism: Snakes每轮两颗独立公平六面骰，以和数索引该difficulty/round的factor；factor>0才生存，并乘入上一轮累计倍率（逐步八位舍入）；任一零factor灭绝，cashout/末轮付累计乘积×bet。
entries.reclassReason: snakes 两骰之和索引难度的规则是单款玩法。

entries.mechanism: Floor13 Cursed floor在基础monster数上增加一个monster，仅仍有safe门的难度可抽；这一floor使用Cursed对应增长因子。
entries.reclassReason: floor13 的 Cursed 层多一个怪物是该塔游戏的专属修饰，没有可迁移规律。

entries.mechanism: Floor13 Blessed仅monster≥2时可抽，均匀揭示其中一个monster门，该门不可选；safe门数不变而可选门数减少，再按Blessed因子增长claim。
entries.reclassReason: floor13 的 Blessed 层揭示怪物门是该游戏的专属修饰。

entries.mechanism: Floor13 Blackout强制一次选择两扇不同且未揭示的门，只有两者均safe才成功；不足两safe门的难度禁抽Blackout，用双选对应因子结算一次slot。
entries.reclassReason: floor13 的 Blackout 双选规则是该游戏的专属修饰。

entries.mechanism: Floor13全run的Cursed/Blackout共用specialBudget；达到次数后后续抽样直接排除这两条概率带，不重归一化剩余权重，因此Blessed/plain分布随history改变。
entries.fingerprintNote: floor13: Cursed and Blackout share a run-wide budget; exhausted bands are removed without renormalizing.

entries.mechanism: Crucifix 只救一次 monster hit，当前 value 乘 saveKeep、消耗一个 slot、该 slot 不乘 growth，之后切成 uninsured factor。
entries.reclassReason: floor13 的 Crucifix 只保一次的规则是该游戏的专属修饰。

entries.mechanism: Floor13只有最后slot真实safe才能进入Basement，付款为value/E[bonus]×预抽bonus×totalStake；最后slot靠保险救命则直接付haircut后的value，不获bonus。
entries.reclassReason: floor13 的 Basement 奖励只给真正安全的末格，是该游戏的专属规则。

entries.mechanism: Floor13 autobet把picks作为每floor偏好：Blessed偏好撞上已揭示门时替换为最低未揭示门；Blackout自动补最低另一未揭示门；保险save后继续，schedule耗尽按当前value付。
entries.reclassReason: floor13 自动下注的回退选择是单款设计。

entries.mechanism: Floor13 cashout即使尚未pick也接受，但已付opening stake不返还、win=0；abandonment调用同一cashout，不替玩家开门。
entries.fingerprintNote: floor13: cash-out before any pick returns zero; abandonment uses it and plays no door.

entries.mechanism: Flip/RPS/Snakes弃局时只要continue仍可用就自动继续风险，直到终止；Flip固定heads、RPS固定rock，Snakes无决策。
entries.fingerprintNote: flip, rockPaperScissors and snakes continue with heads, rock or no choice until terminal.

entries.mechanism: Pepe/Pump弃局根据当前绝对货币currentPayout>1.5选择takeWin，否则continue；阈值作用于金额而非倍率，因此弃局策略随bet改变。
entries.fingerprintNote: pepe and pump bank only when the current absolute payout exceeds 1.5 currency units, otherwise continue.

entries.mechanism: Moles/GoalStreak/PartyPong/PolarMines弃局先bank合法claim；未取得首次success且仅能continue时自动执行第一次pick/throw，然后再bank或fail；默认pick/aim=0。
entries.fingerprintNote: moles, goalStreak, partyPong and polarMines bank a legal claim; before the first success they play the first available pick at zero.

entries.mechanism: liability cap 取 stake 相对上限、绝对金额上限与平台 maxExposure 的最小值并向 wallet grid 下取整；开局必须覆盖 N 倍 stake，继续只有 pot≤floor(cap/N) 才能开放全部风险方向，否则成功后直接支付余额。
entries.fingerprintNote: highLowHit: opening liability N x stake and the pot limit floor(cap/N) decide which risks stay available.

entries.mechanism: 分别计数风险选择和全部牌 draw：保证移动仅增加 totalDraws；获胜后任一计数达到其 horizon 即 forcedCashout 全部舍入后余额，风险上限优先于 draw 上限。
entries.reclassReason: highLowHit 风险选择与抽牌分开计数及视界规则是单款设计。

entries.mechanism: Kiln 成功 stretch 对 multiplier product 向下取整，再在 setDown 对 stake×haul 向下取整；这两层 floor 属于游戏金额规则，不能替换为最近舍入或只在最后舍入。
entries.fingerprintNote: kiln floors haul x stretch factor after each stretch, then floors stake x haul on setDown.

entries.mechanism: Kiln 达最大 stretch 数或 tMax<tMin 后只允许 setDown；manual 成功不立即 auto-bank，autobet 则在固定 target 不再合法时提早 bank，zero gather 不进入风险阶段。
entries.reclassReason: kiln 只允许 setDown 的停止条件是单款设计。

entries.mechanism: SniperRange 实际用距离线性缩放 sigma 的 Rayleigh 半径 r=sigma×sqrt(-2 ln(max(u,MIN_VALUE)))；以严格 r<bandRadius 确定 bull/inner/edge，否则 miss，绝不按四舍五入后的公布 probability 表抽环。

entries.mechanism: Baccarat 每手前依据 strategy 算下一 stake；stake 超玩家 tableLimit 就结束 run（开局也允许零手结算），不足 bankroll 同样结束；Roulette 同类系统超 tableLimit 会先 reset 到 opening progression 再尝试，仍超限才拒绝整个未玩 spin。
entries.fingerprintNote: baccarat-1000 stops (including zero-hand runs); roulette-1000 resets then retries.

entries.fingerprintNote: baccarat-1000 deals Player, Banker, Player, Banker and then compares totals.

entries.mechanism: Baccarat Banker 获胜的 net profit 先按 stakeUnits×commissionPercent/100 半向上舍入到 wallet unit，commission=stake−rounded net；开局与恢复对 base stake 强制最低 commission floor，避免低 stake 的舍入使 Banker commission 为零，该 floor 对所有 selection 一视同仁。
entries.fingerprintNote: baccarat-1000: banker profit is half-up(0.95 x stake units) and every selection's base stake must satisfy the commission floor.

entries.mechanism: Baccarat 仅在每手开头检查剩余牌≤reshuffleAt 就从同一持久 stream 洗新整鞋、cursor归零；一手永不跨鞋，后续 chunks 继续旧鞋和 stream，洗牌不另行取 platform words。
entries.fingerprintNote: baccarat-1000 reshuffles a full shoe when remaining cards <= reshuffleAt, checked before each hand only.

entries.mechanism: Baccarat 下注 selection 与 progression 独立：固定 Player/Banker/Tie；follow 背上一非Tie赢家、opposite 背其相反侧；alternate/pattern 以 nonTie decisive counter 索引，未有 previous 时 follow/opposite 默认 Banker，Tie 不推进 previous/decisive。
entries.reclassReason: baccarat-1000 的选边策略（跟随/相反/交替/图案）是该游戏的策略配置，不是行业标准规则。

entries.mechanism: Martingale 根据当前失利深度指数加倍下一 stake，赢后回到 base；Baccarat push 冻结、到 maxSteps 的 loss 重置追损深度；Roulette loss 继续累积，直到 tableLimit planner 触发 reset。
entries.fingerprintNote: roulette-1000 keeps loss depth until the table-limit reset instead of a max-step reset.

entries.mechanism: Paroli 根据连续获胜深度指数加倍下一 stake，输后归 base，达到可用 winning-step cap 后获胜亦归 base；Baccarat push 保持深度并受 maxSteps，Roulette 用其固定连胜深度 cap。
entries.fingerprintNote: baccarat-1000 uses configured maxSteps; roulette-1000 a fixed streak cap.

entries.mechanism: D'Alembert 用当前单位数×base stake：输加一个单位、赢减一个单位但不低于base；Baccarat unit step 不超过 maxSteps且push不变，Roulette 由 tableLimit reset 截断而非 maxSteps。
entries.fingerprintNote: baccarat-1000 freezes pushes and caps steps; roulette-1000 relies on the table-limit reset.

entries.mechanism: Fibonacci 的 stake 按递推序列当前索引乘base；输了向前一步、赢了退两步但不低于base；Baccarat push冻结且maxSteps loss归起点，Roulette 先把索引饱和于序列表尾、另由 tableLimit reset。
entries.fingerprintNote: roulette-1000 saturates the Fibonacci sequence, then applies table limits; baccarat-1000 resets at maxSteps.

entries.mechanism: Baccarat 的 1-3-2-6 system 取配置单位序列当前项；赢推进、输重置，达到序列/最大允许步骤后赢也重置，Push不移动步骤。
entries.fingerprintNote: baccarat-1000: configured sequence and max-step truncation; pushes preserve position.

entries.mechanism: Roulette Labouchère 用 cancel line 首尾之和下注（单项取该项）；win删首尾、loss把本次staked units追加末尾；清空line时bank目标并恢复初始line，tableLimit reset也恢复初始line。

entries.fingerprintNote: roulette-1000 James Bond spread: ratios fixed, whole-chip plan under tableLimit, unplayed spins rejected.

entries.mechanism: Roulette 单零落袋对所有已下注spot共享；spot覆盖集合包含落袋就各付本金+profit赔率，重叠命中全部累计，未命中为零，zero不属于任何outside target且不存在 la partage/en prison；manual mode 每spin重复相同layout。
entries.fingerprintNote: roulette-1000 manual mode repeats the same layout each spin.

entries.mechanism: Blackjack1000 下注必须是偶数个wallet units，使natural的半单位利润与insurance半stake精确，odd-unit stake在开局拒绝；不使用其他Blackjack的odd-unit floor payout规则。

entries.fingerprintNote: blackjack-1000 peeks after the four initial cards; a player natural pays at once when the dealer has none.

entries.fingerprintNote: blackjack-1000: value pairs, each child's second card deferred to its turn, eligible AA re-splits within hand caps.

entries.mechanism: Blackjack player policy 先处理 pair，再处理 soft/hard total；每格包含 primary Double/Split 和在 rule/funding 不可执行时的 Hit/Stand fallback。

entries.mechanism: small/big 按总和区间判赢；odd/even 按总和奇偶判赢；四种下注遇任何三同号都输。

entries.mechanism: 在 OPEN 且 tick deadline 前，free undo 对调用者自己的 ticket 按 commandId/clientCommandId/groupId 的并集匹配，可一次撤多个且每张至多一次；整张 ticket 从表删除并通过其原 commandId cancels 退 debit，重复 undo 无命中返回零退款而非另付一份 wins。
entries.fingerprintNote: world-spin undoes caller-owned tickets matching the union of command, client and group IDs.

entries.mechanism: 迁移读取的 sharedCommand legacy tickets 因共享一次 debit 而不允许 mid-round undo；即便与新 ticket 同时被选中，也只撤新票，legacy 留表正常终局支付；已处理 legacy command 重放不得再次 cancels。
entries.fingerprintNote: world-spin legacy sharedCommand tickets share one debit and cannot be undone mid-round.

entries.mechanism: 迁移读取的 pendingReleases 是历史已撤 stake 的 deferred refund liability：正常 settlement 把它加到现有 returns 的同 roundId 单次 credit；fatal void 也把它加到 refunds；终局清空，新 round 不再携带，也不产生新 held entries。
entries.fingerprintNote: world-spin legacy pendingReleases are deferred refund liabilities merged once into returns or fatal refunds.

entries.mechanism: 在 tick OPEN 可解析的 conflicting reuse 中，已有 nonlegacy commandId 若 roundId/player/fingerprint 不同，代码仍输出该已有 commandId 的 cancels，但不删除其现有 bet；仅 legacy sharedCommand 拦截这种取消。
entries.fingerprintNote: world-spin: a conflicting reuse of a non-legacy command ID can cancel the existing command while its held bet stays.
entries.question: world-spin 非旧版命令 ID 冲突复用可能取消既有命令却保留其持有的投注：这是 MSS 缺陷还是有意行为？需联合核对平台借记冲正与终局派彩。规律陈述写的是应有行为（冲突复用不得取消原借记）。

entries.mechanism: 概率 gate 先把 targetRTP/multiplier 乘 integer source scale，四舍五入成 nearest integer chanceUnits；uniform integer roll 严格小于该 band 才胜，因此 realized RTP 由已量化 band 决定而非未量化 p。
entries.fingerprintNote: giftBox converts targetRTP / multiplier x integer source size to chanceUnits and wins when the uniform roll is below them.

entries.mechanism: 省略 betLimits 的可达调用允许浮点金额，baseStake、gross return 和 aggregate return 用 toPrecision(15) 的有效数字归一化；有 betLimits 则必须按 wallet-unit/decimal atoms 精确整除，超出安全整数界或 off-grid 直接拒绝。PIERCING 仍要求 wallet grid，不能走无 limits 分配路径。
entries.fingerprintNote: giftBox: exact wallet atoms with betLimits; legacy no-limits routes normalize to fifteen significant digits.

entries.mechanism: 当前 layout 的 shot origin 沿 hinge→aim 的单位方向伸出 muzzleDistance，再将 origin 坐标取整；direction 仍用未取整的 hinge→aim；只接受 aim 在 hinge 上方。旧 persisted layout v1/v2 则固定 muzzle 作 origin/direction。

v3 在 authoritative shotTime 冻结所有 OPEN targets 的圆心；沿瞄准 primary 的 ray，只保留 center projection 非负且不超过 stage exit、圆到 ray 距离在 radius 内的目标，再按 center projection 和 target ID 排序。STANDARD 锁首目标，可与客户端 primary 不同；PIERCING 锁所有相交目标。
PIERCING ray 相交目标数超过上限时整 shot 拒绝，不截取前几腿；v3 plan 从 tick 开始 snapshot 锁目标，处理时只要任何 locked target 已不 OPEN，就在 RNG 前将整 shot VOID/refund，不保留其余腿。
entries.reclassReason: giftBox 穿透射击的整笔作废规则是单款射击结算设计。

entries.mechanism: Target 的权威位置用两轴不同 period/phase 的 sin patrol 计算并 round 坐标；generation replacement 在 tick 末同 slot 换新 ID、固定 multiplier，按 generation/slot 轮换左/上/右屏外入场。入场用 smoothstep 插值到 entryEnd 的巡逻位置，再叠半正弦弧；旧 persisted patrol 仅 exact-match 旧 schema 时投影到新 motion。

v4 Ricochet 按 flight sample intervals 将 target 的时变圆心线性近似，在每段用 projectile-target relative swept segment 解首次进圆；如果起点已在圆内按段起点 CONTACT，选 quantized microsecond 时间最早的目标，相等用 target ID；CONTACT 与同 microsecond boundary 相等时优先 CONTACT。
v4 轨迹以固定 speed 前进到最早 stage boundary，反射对应轴；corner 同时反射两轴，bottom 也可反射。达到 flight lifetime 或 boundary-event 上限先结束为 no-contact terminal；计数单位是 boundary event，corner 不是两次。

v4 不按 client aimTargetRoundId 付钱：接受时只存 authoritative path、CONTACT target 与 full return，terminalAt=shotTime+ceil(flightTimeUs/1000)，到期才 settlement。无 CONTACT（lifetime/bounce limit）或锁定 generation 已失效则取消 debit/退款且不消费 payout RNG；有效 CONTACT 才抽一个 Bernoulli，MISS 扣 wager并付0。
entries.reclassReason: giftBox 反弹射击的延迟结算与 MISS/VOID 区分是单款设计。

entries.mechanism: 同一 money room 所有 life 必须等于 tier 固定 stake；每人最多一个 open life；首 life 锁住 currency/precision，只有无 open life 且账本平衡时解锁并重置 epoch。
entries.fingerprintNote: hitShooter also fixes the stake per life by room tier and allows one open life per player; a new epoch releases the lock.

entries.mechanism: lowest-free seat 分配与 FIFO holding queue 不允许插队；open life 的 seat 不可 stand/idle-release；闲置 queue 过期后继续按队头升席。
entries.fingerprintNote: hitShooter forbids stand and idle-release while a life is open.

entries.mechanism: unboard 仅在 life 未 arming 且 arm 时间窗未到时退原 stake，并保留 seat；kill/death/report/leave 会 arming，已 armed life 必须走终局而不能撤回下注。
entries.fingerprintNote: hitShooter: kill, death, report or leave arms the life, after which only terminal settlement applies.

entries.mechanism: leave 会锁住 life 并延迟退出：等待时禁止新的 world controls/攻击但身体仍可被击杀；deadline 所在完整 step 的 KILL/DEATH 先于 EXIT，之后移除身体，存活才取本金和 bank。
entries.reclassReason: hitShooter 离开后的延迟退出与脆弱期是单款对战设计。

entries.mechanism: vanished 依据 seat transport stamp 与 life 接受时间的最大值，而非 sim lastInputAt；无待处理 leave 的存活 life 静默超时被当作 alive leave，支付 stake+bank。
entries.fingerprintNote: hitShooter: after a silent timeout with no pending leave, a surviving life settles as an alive leave for stake plus bank.

entries.mechanism: kill 只转移 victim 原 stake；victim 原 bank 全归 house，不由 killer 继承；killer 不在 open lives 或计数到 cap 时整笔 victim stake 归 house；合法额外 kill 仍增加计数。
entries.reclassReason: hitShooter 击杀转移本金的规则是该游戏的经济设计。

entries.mechanism: 同 step 先推进所有玩家的 reload/recoil/movement，再按 projectile 插入次序处理既存飞行弹和死亡，最后按 player id code-unit 次序处理新攻击；新发 projectile 下一步开始飞行，同 tick 先后可改变谁先死亡。
projectile/beam 的 owner 必须仍是同一当前玩家、alive、相同 lifeId 且未 disconnected/leaving；已登记 leave 但尚未 EXIT 的 alive owner 也立即失去在途弹命中资格；失效 projectile 丢弃，beam 另要求有效武器/弹药且无 reload。
entries.reclassReason: hitShooter 弹体与光束所有者存活校验是单款对战规则。

entries.mechanism: fixed-step catch-up 保留 fractional debt，输入按 ceil(time-epoch)/step 分窗，迟到夹到 firstStep、未来夹到 now；逐玩家 seq 倒序回拉保障发送次序，waiting+fresh 有共同容量：held 不被 newcomer 淘汰，fresh 按 step/time/seq/arrival 排序只收剩余容量内最早者、溢出丢弃；跨 SIM_MS 重计 step 时向上取整。
entries.fingerprintNote: hitShooter assigns input steps by ceil((time - epoch) / step), clamps late and future times and orders per-player sequences.

entries.mechanism: idle money world 不累计无人时钟债；首 life 若存在 idle debt 则 fresh re-epoch，同时 world/death 先于当 tick 新 main/unboard，不能借同 tick 撤注逃过已经发生的死亡。
entries.fingerprintNote: hitShooter resolves world deaths before the current tick's main and unboard commands.

entries.mechanism: 出生点先排除拥挤，依次优先 sheltered/hidden/最远 fallback；对真人威胁按 nav sight-walk、直线距离、index 排名，再用 lifeId 的 FNV-1a 在候选 index 序列中选择；无威胁先用 seat 点。
只有 fresh input 通过 age gate 才推进水平移动和 jump/vertical motion；移动按 sprint→ADS→walk 优先，weapon 改变步速；归一化输入后逐轴小步滑墙，支持高度限制步上/跌落；jump 只消费 grounded press，重力落到最高支撑，撞顶停止上升并限制可跨下落高度。
有效 input 必须是活体新 seq/非倒退时钟；firePressed 缓冲第一 press 的 aim 到 TTL，release 不消除，cancel/换武器消除；不合资格 press 丢弃；held fire 和 click 使用同一 certified fire-grid 的不同 admission/cooldown 窗口，sprint 禁止攻击。
每 life 初始化有满匣 sidearm；magazine 限制连射但 reserve 不消耗，空匣自动 reload；tactical reload 保留 deadline；同武器 switch 不动状态，真正换武器清 press/reload/beam，却保留 recoil 与 attack deadline。
weapon pickup 按 server 三维距离与 available 检查，成功自动 equip 并进入 respawn；重复当前远程武器补满可用 magazine 而不缩短已运行 reload；若捡到另一已持有武器，自动 switch 会取消当前 reload；重复 melee 拒绝；现行 runtime 删除 ammo crates。
发射先用当前残余 recoil 修正 aim，再增长确定性 pattern；移动/ADS 改 kick，shot 后 hold 结束才指数衰减，衰减到阈值才重置 pattern；melee 不用 recoil。
projectile 冻结发射时武器规则，重力分段 swept 到最近 world/body；range 限制和 lifetime 结束弹丸；travel distance 线性衰减 damage 后取整，body capsule 的入口高于 neck 且穿 head sphere 才是 head，head damage 再取整，hp 到零生成 death。
不同 attack modes：pellet 一颗 shell/一次 kick 产生固定 fan 的多个 projectile，无随机 spread；melee 无 ammo/recoil 而单近距 trace；beam 持续 hold 并以 damage cadence 逐量消耗 ammo、可被 world/ground 阻挡，最终 energy quantum 后清 beam。

void 使用 tick-entry 原状态而非半修改状态；只有 room precision 合法、row precision 相同、stake/bank 可解析且 stake>0、stake+bank≤stake×MAX_RETURN_MULTIPLE 的 open row 才支付 stake+bank，其余可识别行仅 cancel 原 debit；退回 tick 当批新 debit，并排除早前 terminal 与此次已付款行，保留 watermark/tombstone。
entries.fingerprintNote: hitShooter pays stake plus bank only on precision-matching readable positive rows within the maximum return.

entries.mechanism: 只有有 open lives 时在 tick 开头检查 time−lar≥authorityGraceMs；达到阈值不继续 catch-up 而立即 whole-room void，按原状态恢复；首 life purchase 总刷新 lar。
entries.fingerprintNote: hitShooter checks the authority gap at tick start; the first life refreshes the authority timestamp.

entries.mechanism: terminal IDs 在当前 retention epoch 中不按 count 淘汰；跨 epoch 仅删 mark 之前且非 open-life 的 IDs；void 超 byte budget 时暂停新命令并等待 retirement，不能丢 terminal IDs 来缩小状态。
entries.fingerprintNote: hitShooter retires only older non-open identities across epochs.

entries.mechanism: Outcome/cause 合法矩阵：killed 只允许 kill/mutual/shared/death，extracted 只允许 exit/vanished/crash，refunded 只允许 unredeemed/early-exit；Shooter 禁 shared/early-exit，Spaceship 禁 death，即使签名正确也拒绝。
entries.reclassReason: build-signed-realtime-settlement 第 4 步已教“签名后校验结果/原因合法性与逐游戏 GAME_CAUSES”；余下是 hitShooterLife/hitSpaceshipLife 两款的矩阵单元格。

entries.mechanism: Kill-credit legality：kill/mutual 的 killedBy 必须是别的 life，其他 cause 必须为-；refunded 不得有 kills。Victim 不得是自己/命名 killer，不得重复；列表按 numeric tick 后 ASCII victim 严格升序，每项 tick<=endTick，同 tick 的不同 victim可存在。
entries.reclassReason: build-signed-realtime-settlement 第 4 步已教 (epoch,tick) 排序、拒绝回退与去重；余下是两款游戏的字段与杀手规则细节。
